name: PipeBench
description: The integration of machine learning (ML) into modern data management systems has enabled intelligent decision-making across large-scale information infrastructures. However, existing performance benchmarks typically evaluate isolated components such as model training or inference, leaving the behavior of full end-to-end pipelines poorly understood. This paper introduces PipeBench, a reproducible benchmarking framework for evaluating integrated ML pipelines that combine distributed data processing, automated machine learning (AutoML), model management, and production serving.
